title: Training Note: Earlier Withdrawals Counted Against the Free Amount of a Corrected Partial-Withdrawal Charge, Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
This training note covers one point of the corrected partial-withdrawal charge on Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts: which withdrawals taken earlier in the withdrawal's contract year use up its free amount.

## The rule

The earlier withdrawals that use up the free amount of a corrected partial-withdrawal charge are:

1. on a **traditional IRA or SEP IRA** contract with **required minimum distribution withdrawals** earlier in the withdrawal's contract year — every earlier withdrawal of that contract year **except** the required minimum distribution withdrawals;
2. on **any other contract** with withdrawals taken earlier in that contract year **under an approved surrender charge waiver** — every earlier withdrawal of that contract year **except** the waiver withdrawals;
3. otherwise — every earlier withdrawal of that contract year.

The tax registration is the one on the contract record. The activity history classifies each withdrawal: required minimum distribution withdrawals, and waiver withdrawals (partial withdrawals taken under an approved nursing home or terminal illness waiver), are shown as such.

## Questions answered (hypothetical contracts; earlier withdrawals of the same contract year)

**A traditional IRA contract had a $3000 required minimum distribution withdrawal and a $2000 partial withdrawal. What uses up the free amount?** $2000 — the required minimum distribution withdrawal is left out.

**A Roth IRA contract had a $3000 required minimum distribution withdrawal and nothing else. What uses up the free amount?** $3000. The first line covers traditional and SEP IRA contracts only; with no waiver withdrawals, the third line applies.

**A non-qualified contract had a $5000 waiver withdrawal and a $1000 partial withdrawal. What uses up the free amount?** $1000 — the waiver withdrawal is left out.

**A traditional IRA contract had a $3000 required minimum distribution withdrawal, a $5000 waiver withdrawal and a $1000 partial withdrawal. What uses up the free amount?** $6000. The first line applies, so only the required minimum distribution withdrawal is left out.

**A SEP IRA contract had no required minimum distribution withdrawal, a $4000 waiver withdrawal and a $1500 partial withdrawal. What uses up the free amount?** $1500 — the first line does not apply, so the contract falls under the second.

## Summary table

| Tax registration | Required minimum distribution withdrawals earlier in the contract year | Waiver withdrawals earlier in the contract year | Earlier withdrawals that use up the free amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Traditional or SEP IRA | Yes | Yes or no | All except the required minimum distribution withdrawals |
| Traditional or SEP IRA | No | Yes | All except the waiver withdrawals |
| Roth IRA or non-qualified | Yes or no | Yes | All except the waiver withdrawals |
| Traditional or SEP IRA | No | No | All earlier withdrawals |
| Roth IRA or non-qualified | Yes or no | No | All earlier withdrawals |
